name: Chef

sections.daily_work: Design and cook dishes. Manage kitchen staff and operations. Source ingredients. Maintain food safety standards. Create menus. Handle high-pressure service periods.
sections.learning: Cooking techniques, knife skills, flavor pairing, menu design, kitchen management, food safety (ServSafe), inventory and cost control, plating and presentation.
sections.pay: Line cooks start around $12-$18/hour USD. Sous chefs $40,000-$60,000. Executive chefs at restaurants can earn $60,000-$100,000+. Celebrity chefs earn more. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Culinary school or apprenticeship, starting as a prep cook, working up through kitchen ranks (line cook, sous chef, chef de cuisine), self-taught with mentorship.

try_in_real_life: Cook a new recipe from scratch every week for a month
Practice knife skills with basic cuts (julienne, dice, chiffonade)
Stage (intern) at a restaurant kitchen for a day
Research culinary schools and their program offerings
sources: American Culinary Federation surveys; BLS chefs and head cooks data
